lines.en: label ayanespring3:
scene black
After the last bell has rung and the doors have been opened...
lines.zh: 最后的铃声响过，门也已经打开之后……

lines.en: scene ayanemakotoofficemeet1
: Meeting — start! Attendance will now be taken. Makoto!
lines.zh: : 会议——开始！现在点名。Makoto！

lines.en: : Present.
scene ayanemakotoofficemeet2
: Wonderful. That concludes the taking of attendance. We may now proceed with the matters at hand.
lines.zh: : 很好。点名到此结束。现在我们可以进入正题了。

lines.en: : Which are...what, exactly?
lines.zh: : 正题是……具体是什么呢？

lines.en: : Oh, you know. Assorted apocalypse stuff. What we’re going to wear for the next reset. How I’m your new best friend. Things like that.
lines.zh: : 哦，你知道的。各种末日相关的事。下一次重置的时候我们穿什么。我是你的新闺蜜了。诸如此类。

lines.en: scene ayanemakotoofficemeet3
: Okay, but you’re going to have to be the one to break the news to Miku.
lines.zh: : 行吧，不过跟 Miku 摊牌这事得由你来。

lines.en: : Losing me leaves her with either Kirin, Io, or my mom as her new best friend. And I’m sure you can see the negative impact any of them would have on her.
lines.zh: : 失去我之后，她的闺蜜候选人就只剩 Kirin、Io，或者我妈了。我相信你也能看出来，她们任何一个都会对她造成多坏的影响。

lines.en: : Isn’t Miku becoming a little sex gremlin thing now? Wouldn’t that mean that you have also had a negative impact on her?
lines.zh: : Miku 现在不是快变成一只性爱小妖精了吗？那不就说明你对她的影响也很坏？

lines.en: : Yes. It is my fault. Not the fault of the adult man who claimed her virginity with the same amount of thought he’d put into redeeming a 500 yen scratch off ticket.
lines.zh: : 对。是我的错。不是那个成年男人的错——他夺走她处女的时候，花的心思跟兑现一张 500 日元刮刮乐差不多。

lines.en: scene ayanemakotoofficemeet4
: Is all that stuff I've been hearing about him breaking her vagina really true?
lines.zh: : 我最近一直听人说的那些，关于他把她那儿弄坏了的事，是真的吗？

lines.en: : No comment.
lines.zh: : 无可奉告。

lines.en: : Not even a little comment? A tiny one? You really won’t spare any details for your new best friend?
lines.zh: : 一句也不行？就一句小小的？你真的不肯给你新闺蜜透露一点细节？

lines.en: : Sorry — where is this sudden interest in Miku’s vagina coming from? Is there something you’re not telling me, Ayane?
lines.zh: : 抱歉——你怎么突然对 Miku 的阴道这么感兴趣了？是不是有什么你没告诉我的事，Ayane？

lines.en: : No, but there’s something you’re not telling me.
lines.zh: : 没有，倒是有什么你没告诉我的。

lines.en: scene ayanemakotoofficemeet5
: I am willing to look past that if it brings us closer together, though.
lines.zh: : 不过，如果那能让我们更亲近，我愿意不计较。

lines.en: : It won’t, but okay.
lines.zh: : 那不会，不过行吧。

lines.en: : Vaginas aside! It’s time to continue planning our escape from this mortal coil. And seeing as I have so far been the idea girl, I am now passing the torch to you.
lines.zh: : 先不说阴道了！是时候继续规划我们逃离这具凡胎的计划了。既然到目前为止一直是我出主意，现在我把接力棒交给你。

lines.en: : Wait, me?
lines.zh: : 等等，我？

lines.en: : Yes. You. Who else am I going to pass it to?
lines.zh: : 对。你。我不交给你，还能交给谁？

lines.en: scene ayanemakotoofficemeet6
: Well, for one, Yumi still exists. Which you may or may not have forgotten based on the fact that you didn’t invite her to our meeting.
lines.zh: : 首先，Yumi 还活着呢。你大概是忘了，要不就是根本没想过要邀请她来开会。

lines.en: : Yumi doesn’t want to be involved in any of the apocalypse stuff, though.
lines.zh: : 可 Yumi 根本不想掺和末日那些事啊。

lines.en: : And I do? Correct me if I’m wrong, but I’m pretty sure I have verbally stated on several occasions now that things are better for me here. Why would I want to get out of this timeloop?
lines.zh: : 那我就想了？要是我记错了你纠正我，但我很确定我已经好几次口头声明过，我在这里过得更好。我干嘛要想办法从这个时间循环里出去？

lines.en: : It’s less that you’d want to get out and more the fact that you’re the type of person who habitually solves problems. And what bigger problem is there than this?
lines.zh: : 与其说你想出去，不如说你是那种习惯性地去解决问题的人。而还有什么问题比这个更大？

lines.en: : Oh, okay. So you’re just taking advantage of my intellect then.
lines.zh: : 哦，行啊。所以你只是在利用我的才智。

lines.en: scene ayanemakotoofficemeet7
: Right.
lines.zh: : 没错。

lines.en: : And you have no shame regarding this at all.
lines.zh: : 而且你对此一点都不觉得害臊。

lines.en: : Nope. Not even a little. So, what’s your plan?
lines.zh: : 不。一点点都不。那么，你的计划是什么？

lines.en: : I don’t have one.
lines.zh: : 我没有计划。

lines.en: : Buuuut, if you were to come up with one, what would it be?
lines.zh: : 但——是——，如果你要现想一个的话，会是什么？

lines.en: : I’m not asking you to figure out time travel in one sitting. I just want something to run with and build off of.
lines.zh: : 我不是要你一次坐着就把时间旅行给搞明白。我只是想有个能拿去跑、能往上搭的东西。

lines.en: : And I’ve had my hands too full with my own misery lately to be able to come up with anything worth trying.
lines.zh: : 而且我最近光顾着自己难受了，实在腾不出手来想出什么值得一试的点子。

lines.en: : Well, we could maybe start by finding you a therapist.
lines.zh: : 这个嘛，也许我们可以先给你找个心理医生。

lines.en: scene ayanemakotoofficemeet8
: Denied. I am formally requesting a new idea.
lines.zh: : 驳回。我正式要求换一个新点子。

lines.en: : And I am formally requesting that you take my legs off of your lap. How did you get there so quickly?
lines.zh: : 我也正式要求你把我的腿从你大腿上放下来。它们是怎么这么快就跑上去的？

lines.en: : Doesn’t matter. What does matter is that we create a comfortable environment for one another. And sometimes, mild physical touch can help with that!
lines.zh: : 不重要。重要的是我们要为彼此营造一个舒适的环境。而有时候，轻微的身体接触对此有帮助！

lines.en: : Or, and hear me out here, make everything way less comfortable.
lines.zh: : 或者，你听我把话说完，让一切都变得没那么舒适。

lines.en: : Jeez, Makoto. You’d think for someone who’s had a foot-long cock inside of her over a thousand times that you’d be more open to putting your legs on someone’s lap.
lines.zh: : 天哪，Makoto。你说说你，一个被一英尺长的鸡巴进去过一千多次的人，按理说应该更能接受把腿放到别人腿上吧。

lines.en: scene ayanemakotoofficemeet9
: Sorry, do you have a foot-long cock you’ve just never told me about?
lines.zh: : 抱歉，你难道有一根一英尺长的鸡巴，只是从来没跟我说过？

lines.en: : Maybe. Would you think any less of me if I did? And be careful with your answer, Makoto. It’s Pride month.
lines.zh: : 也许吧。如果我真有，你会不会看低我？Makoto，回答之前想清楚哦。这可是骄傲月。

lines.en: scene ayanemakotoofficemeet10
: Okay, you want an idea? Here. I think we should start taking Yumi’s position in our team a little more seriously, whether she wants to be included or not.
lines.zh: : 好吧，你想听点子是吧？给你。我觉得我们应该更认真地对待 Yumi 在团队里的位置，不管她自己想不想参与。

lines.en: : You think she’ll actually go along with it?
lines.zh: : 你觉得她真会配合吗？

lines.en: scene ayanemakotoofficemeet11
: I think she doesn’t have much of a choice. What’s the worst thing that could happen? She says no and we just stay the same way we’ve been since I got thrown into this?
lines.zh: : 我觉得她没什么选择的余地。最坏能怎么样？她说不，然后我们就维持自从我被扔进这儿以来一直的样子？

lines.en: : The worst thing that can happen is that she beats you up. And I wouldn’t be able to live with myself if I put you in danger, Makoto.
lines.zh: : 最坏的情况是她把你揍一顿。而如果我把你置于危险之中，我会一辈子过不去这个坎，Makoto。

lines.en: : Thank you, but I think I’ll be fine.
lines.zh: : 谢谢关心，不过我觉得我不会有事。

lines.en: scene ayanemakotoofficemeet12
: Don’t you think Yumi’s seemed a little off lately though?
lines.zh: : 不过你不觉得 Yumi 最近有点不对劲吗？

lines.en: : Because she’s...actually coming to school? And participating in stuff like the Dorm Wars?
lines.zh: : 因为她……真的来上学了？还参加了宿舍大战之类的活动？

lines.en: : Yeah, exactly. Doesn’t that make you think something might be going on with her?
lines.zh: : 对，就是这个。这难道不让你觉得她可能出了什么事吗？

lines.en: : Could that “something” not just be resignation? Like, maybe she’s accepted this situation already and figures there’s no point in just waiting for it to blow over anymore?
lines.zh: : 那个“什么事”就不能只是认命吗？比如，也许她已经接受了这个处境，觉得再干等着它自己过去已经没有意义了？

lines.en: : I’d agree under normal circumstances. But something about the way she’s been carrying herself lately makes me feel like she’s more sad than anything.
lines.zh: : 正常情况下我会同意。但她最近的一举一动让我觉得，她更多的是难过，而不是别的什么。

lines.en: scene ayanemakotoofficemeet13
: Can Yumi even feel such an emotion?
lines.zh: : Yumi 还会有这种情绪吗？

lines.en: : Of course. Everybody gets sad, Makoto. I’m sure you’ve had a good cry in the bathroom at least once over your time here.
lines.zh: : 当然会。谁都会难过，Makoto。我相信你来这儿这么久，至少也在洗手间里好好哭过一次。

lines.en: : Yeah. My dad just needed to die for it.
lines.zh: : 嗯。得我爸死了才行。

lines.en: : Then I am sorry for making you think about that again. But the fact remains, Yumi seems like she’s not in the sort of mindset we need to make any sort of progress right now.
lines.zh: : 那我很抱歉又让你想起这件事。但事实依然是，Yumi 现在的心态，看起来不是我们取得任何进展所需要的那种。

lines.en: : And what sort of mindset is that, Ayane? Because I was under the impression we just never made any progress here.
lines.zh: : 那是什么样的心态，Ayane？因为我一直以为，我们在这儿从来就没取得过任何进展。

lines.en: : Sure we do. You and Yumi even being able to talk about this is progress. And I’m sure Maya and Sensei would have said the same thing about me when I joined.
lines.zh: : 我们当然有。你和 Yumi 现在能聊这些，本身就是进展。我相信我刚加入的时候，Maya 和 Sensei 也会这么说我。

lines.en: : Yeah, where is he? Shouldn’t he be here too?
lines.zh: : 是啊，他人在哪儿？他不也该在这儿吗？

lines.en: : Probably. In regard to the mindset thing, though, I feel like you and I are the only ones normal enough to figure anything out at the moment.
lines.zh: : 大概是吧。不过说到心态这件事，我觉得眼下只有你和我还算正常，能琢磨出点东西来。

lines.en: : I think you’re gravely overestimating just how much two teenagers can accomplish in the field of metaphysics.
lines.zh: : 我觉得你严重高估了两个高中生在形而上学领域能取得的成就。

lines.en: : Sure. But people would say the same about our ability to receive Sensei’s penis and here we are. Just two penis experts hanging out on a couch.
lines.zh: : 没错。但别人也会这么评价我们承受 Sensei 那根鸡巴的能力，可我们不也过来了吗。就两个鸡巴专家并排坐在沙发上。

lines.en: : Ayane — my idea is simple. We let time run its course and just carry on the same ways we would if we were not involved in a timeloop.
lines.zh: : Ayane——我的点子很简单。我们让时间顺其自然地走下去，就按我们不处在时间循环里时本来的方式继续生活。

lines.en: : Trying to interfere with any of it will likely just confuse us more or, even worse, fuck something up. Is that really something we want to risk?
lines.zh: : 试图干预其中任何一环，很可能只会让我们更糊涂，或者更糟，把什么事搞砸。这真的是我们愿意冒的风险吗？

lines.en: scene ayanemakotoofficemeet14
: Hah...no. It’s just that “letting time run its course” is exactly what Maya did. And if she were here today, she’d be jumping at every single opportunity to actually do something.
lines.zh: : 哈……不。只是“顺其自然”正是 Maya 做过的事。而如果她今天在这儿，她一定会抓住每一个机会，真正去做点什么。

lines.en: : Just...she is here today. And you’re more than welcome to try talking to her about any of this if you want. I’m sure the old her would have approved of that too.
lines.zh: : 可是……她今天确实在这儿啊。你要是想跟她聊这些，随时可以去。我相信以前那个她也会赞成你这么做的。

lines.en: : I have been trying. It’s just...
lines.zh: : 我一直在试着聊。只是……

lines.en: scene ayanemakotoofficemeet15
: It...hurts.
lines.zh: : 那很……疼。

lines.en: : Sensei’s not the only one affected by her disappearance. And being able to experience this with her, like...formed a bond that felt...really special to me.
lines.zh: : 受她消失影响的人不止 Sensei 一个。能和她一起经历这些，就像……形成了一种……对我来说非常特别的羁绊。

lines.en: : Well...I’m sorry I’m not her. And I’m sorry I’m not approaching things the way she would.
lines.zh: : 嗯……很抱歉我不是她。也很抱歉我没有用她会用的方式来处理这些事。

lines.en: : But she is still here. So there has to be something the two of you can-
lines.zh: : 但她还在这儿。所以你们两个之间一定有什——

lines.en: : She’s weird too, though. And lately, I...
lines.zh: : 可她现在也很怪。而且最近，我……

lines.en: scene ayanemakotoofficemeet16
: You what? What is that expression?
lines.zh: : 你什么？你那是什么表情？

lines.en: scene ayanemakotoofficemeet17
: Just...out of curiosity...have you noticed anything odd about the way she’s been with Ami lately?
lines.zh: : 只是……出于好奇……你有没有注意到她最近跟 Ami 在一起时的样子有什么奇怪的？

lines.en: : I feel like we’re at a point in this timeline where every single interaction with Ami is going to be “weird” in some way or another.
lines.zh: : 我觉得在这个时间线上，我们已经到了跟 Ami 的每一次互动都会以某种方式显得“奇怪”的地步了。

lines.en: : Well, yes. But I can’t help but feel like the two of them are hiding something from me. From everyone. And neither one of them will clue me in on it.
lines.zh: : 嗯，是的。但我就是忍不住觉得，她们两个在对我隐瞒什么。对所有人都隐瞒。而且她们谁都不肯透露一点口风。

lines.en: : Hmm...maybe they’ve started a second “Love Squad” specific to only those with A-cups?
lines.zh: : 嗯……也许她们另起了一个只准 A 罩杯加入的“恋爱小队”？

lines.en: : Or maybe they just don’t trust me the way they used to...
lines.zh: : 或者也许她们只是不再像以前那样信任我了……

lines.en: scene ayanemakotoofficemeet18
: Well, you did lose the Maya you apparently had a “special bond” with. So I imagine this one wouldn’t just inherently trust you right off the bat.
lines.zh: : 这个嘛，你确实失去了那个据你说和你有“特殊羁绊”的 Maya。所以我想，眼前这个不会一上来就本能地信任你。

lines.en: : Right, I get that. And I wouldn’t expect that either. But it’s like...
lines.zh: : 对，我懂。我也没指望她会。但就是……

lines.en: : I can hang out with Ami and everything will be normal. I can talk to Maya and everything will be “normal.”
lines.zh: : 我和 Ami 待在一起，一切都正常。我和 Maya 说话，一切都“正常”。

lines.en: : But when the two of them are together, it always feels like I’m being left out of something.
lines.zh: : 但当她们两个凑到一起的时候，总觉得有什么事把我排除在外。

lines.en: : And I don’t know...maybe it’s just karma for Maya and I making Ami feel that way before everything happened. But maybe it’s more?
lines.zh: : 我不知道……也许这只是报应，毕竟在一切发生之前，Maya 和我曾让 Ami 也有过那种感觉。但也说不定不止于此？

lines.en: : What would “more” even be, though? It’s not like they’re secretly having sex behind closed doors or anything.
lines.zh: : 可“不止于此”又能是什么呢？总不会是她们背地里关起门来偷偷上床之类的吧。

lines.en: scene ayanemakotoofficemeet19
: That’s the part I can’t figure out. And any time I try to probe Ami for answers, she just gaslights me into thinking everything’s completely normal.
lines.zh: : 这正是我想不通的地方。而且每次我想从 Ami 那儿探点口风，她都会反过来对我洗脑，让我觉得一切都完全正常。

lines.en: : Well, that’s no surprise at all given her relationship with Sensei and how she likely does the same with him.
lines.zh: : 这倒是完全不意外，考虑到她跟 Sensei 的关系，以及她很可能也对他做同样的事。

lines.en: : If I were you, I wouldn’t be probing her at all. I’d be trying to figure things out from Maya instead. At least she can likely be annoyed into submission.
lines.zh: : 如果我是你，我根本不会去探她。我会转而去从 Maya 身上想办法。至少她很可能被你烦到投降为止。

lines.en: : My relationship with Ami is different, though. She and I have always been really close. She’s basically my little sister.
lines.zh: : 可我和 Ami 的关系不一样。我们一直都很亲密。她基本就是我妹妹。

lines.en: : Or...maybe she just wants you to think you’re really close and the reality is that she’d stab you in the back at any moment if it meant getting closer to what she really wants?
lines.zh: : 或者……也许她只是想让你以为你们很亲密，而实际上，只要能让她更接近真正想要的东西，她随时都会在你背后捅一刀？

lines.en: : She can’t, though.
lines.zh: : 她不会的。

lines.en: : What do you mean she “can’t?”
lines.zh: : 什么叫她“不会”？

lines.en: : I mean she literally can’t. My guardian angel told me as much.
lines.zh: : 我是说她真的做不到。我的守护天使是这么告诉我的。

lines.en: scene ayanemakotoofficemeet20
: Your what?
lines.zh: : 你的什么？

lines.en: : You wouldn’t get it. In fact, I don’t really get it. But questioning seemingly paranormal entities here has never led me to any good, so I just listen to them now.
lines.zh: : 你不会懂的。事实上，我自己也不太懂。但在这里追问那些看起来超自然的东西，从来没给我带来过什么好结果，所以我现在就听着呗。

lines.en: : Ayane, if Big Boi has been secretly visiting you at night, you should probably let me know.
lines.zh: : Ayane，如果 Big Boi 一直在夜里偷偷去找你，你大概该让我知道。

lines.en: : It’s not Big Boi, I swear.
lines.zh: : 不是 Big Boi，我发誓。

lines.en: scene ayanemakotoofficemeet21
: I wonder how he’s doing, though.
lines.zh: : 不过我挺想知道他现在怎么样了。

lines.en: : Yeah. He kind of just showed up that one time and then disappeared forever.
lines.zh: : 是啊。他就那么出现过一次，然后就永远消失了。

lines.en: scene ayanemakotoofficemeet22
: Oh. Hi, Imani.
lines.zh: : 哦。嗨，Imani。

lines.en: : Guys, I know it’s Pride month, but if the two of you are going to do lesbian stuff together, you should at least do it in the dorms.
lines.zh: : 两位，我知道现在是骄傲月，但如果你们要搞女同性恋那一套，至少也该回宿舍去搞。

lines.en: : We’re not doing lesbian stuff, though. We’re having a meeting.
lines.zh: : 我们没在搞女同性恋那一套。我们在开会。

lines.en: : A meeting that requires Makoto’s legs in your lap?
lines.zh: : 开会需要把 Makoto 的腿放在你大腿上？

lines.en: : For what it’s worth, I also told her this was not conducive to a proper setting for a meeting.
lines.zh: : 我说句公道话，我也跟她说过，这不利于营造适合开会的氛围。

lines.en: : The hell are you two having a “meeting” for anyway? School ended an hour ago. Shouldn’t you be out having fun and being social and shit?
lines.zh: : 你们两个到底在开什么“会”？学校一个小时前就放学了。你们不该出去玩、去社交什么的吗？

lines.en: : Me, probably. Makoto, not so much.
lines.zh: : 我大概是吧。Makoto 就说不准了。

lines.en: : Yeah, I wasn’t really talking about her.
lines.zh: : 是啊，我说的本来就不是她。

lines.en: : I let you use my office and this is how you repay me?
lines.zh: : 我让你用我的办公室，你就这么报答我？

lines.en: scene ayanemakotoofficemeet23
: It ain’t your office, ho! This place belongs to Sensei! And now that he ain’t here, it probably belongs to me!
lines.zh: : 这他妈不是你的办公室，婊子！这地方是 Sensei 的！既然他现在不在这儿，那大概就是我的了！

lines.en: : I’ve been here longer! I have seniority!
lines.zh: : 我在这儿待得更久！我有资历！

lines.en: : I’m your senior! Which should literally imply that I have seniority!
lines.zh: : 我是你的前辈！照字面意思，这就该意味着我有资历！

lines.en: : And I’m Sensei’s wife, which means that half of this office belongs to me.
lines.zh: : 而我是 Sensei 的老婆，也就是说这间办公室有一半是我的。

lines.en: scene ayanemakotoofficemeet24
: Lies! I’m definitely the closest to being his actual wife! But I will not reveal how or why!
lines.zh: : 谎言！我绝对才是最接近他正牌老婆的人！但我不会透露是怎么个接近法、为什么！

lines.en: : Fine, Mrs. Ayane Arakawa. Compromise reached. But I get the half with the desk because I have papers to grade and doing it on the floor of my apartment hurts my back.
lines.zh: : 行吧，Ayane Arakawa 太太。妥协达成。但我要有书桌的那半边，因为我有卷子要批，在我家地板上批会伤到我的背。

lines.en: scene black
: Ooh! Can I get extra credit if I help?
lines.zh: : 哦！如果我帮忙批，能拿加分吗？

lines.en: : Sure. You don’t really need it, though.
lines.zh: : 当然。不过你其实不太需要。

lines.en: : Can I help too or will grades not go higher than 100%%?
lines.zh: : 我也能帮忙吗，还是说分数不能高过 100%%？

lines.en: : You can give your extra credit to Miku. Lord knows she needs it.
lines.zh: : 你可以把你的加分让给 Miku。老天知道她需要。

lines.en: : Ugh. Fine.
lines.zh: : 呃。行吧。

lines.en: : See? This is what I was talking about. You always have to help. It’s in your DNA.
lines.zh: : 你看？我说的就是这个。你总是忍不住要帮忙。这都刻在你 DNA 里了。

lines.en: : Cool! You two handle these then and I’ll go home early. But remember — no lesbian stuff!
lines.zh: : 酷！那你们两个来处理这些，我就早点回家了。不过记住——不许搞女同性恋那一套！

lines.en: : Miss Imai-
lines.zh: : Imai 老师——

lines.en: : Hah. Okay, fine. You can do a little lesbian stuff. But only because it’s Pride month. Above the clothes only. Got it?
lines.zh: : 哈。好吧，好吧。你们可以做一点点女同性恋的事。但只因为现在是骄傲月。只能隔着衣服。明白了吗？

lines.en: : Wha-
: Got it! Thanks, Imani! Love you!
lines.zh: : 明白了！谢谢 Imani！爱你！

lines.en: : Love you too! See you both on Monday!
lines.zh: : 也爱你！周一见，两位！

lines.en: : We’re not lesbians!
lines.zh: : 我们不是女同性恋！

lines.en: : Can’t hear you! Too busy being an ally!
lines.zh: : 听不见！我正忙着当盟友呢！

lines.en: $ ayanespring3 = True
Ayane and Makoto’s affection for one another has increased by 1!
lines.zh: Ayane 和 Makoto 对彼此的好感度提升了 1！

lines.en: They swear it’s not because of gay stuff, though.
lines.zh: 不过她们发誓这跟同性恋那套没关系。
